description: Stage one SiteMe website edit that fixes every failed check (not overridden) on the business's latest linked website report that OnHand can write from the listing's approved details, for one approval. Returns included (each check with the change it makes), skipped (each check left out, with reason: siteme_builds, in_onhand, needs_dns, needs_details, too_long, refused, not_on_siteme, plan, not_available or not_staged, and a message), not_checked, points_if_fixed, website_edit (intent, expires_at, consequence; a refusal; or null when nothing was staged) and next. Show the owner every included change and the exact consequence together; confirm_website_edit applies it after they approve, as one website edit. For a skipped check, prepare_visibility_fix gives its fix. Only on a SiteMe website linked to the report's site, on Pro; fixes are on Live and Pro, and on Listed it returns plan_required. Requires company:write; the account selects the business.
name: prepare_visibility_fixes
title: Prepare website fixes
